name: Franz Byron
source: As one of the top students in Overture’s most prestigious school of magical science, Franz is entrusted with a research project that may revolutionize the magic industry. Unfortunately he isn’t enthusiastic about this research, but will it perhaps lead him to that which he truly desires?
